page.layout: One printed title page: all lines centred, in red and black type. Woodcut ornament between the author's name and the printer's line. Handwritten signature and library stamp at the top, not printed, left out.

main_text.l: Keyf.May. Maximiliani I. vnd Caroli V.
einen vornemmen gelährten Man mit fleiß
zusammen getragen / vnd jetzo erst an
Fernere ParticularInhalt ist nach der Vorred zu finden.
Gedruckt zu Nürnberg bey Paul Kauffmann/ im Jahr

page.notes: The initial of "Tugend" is a large red decorated letter, hard to make out; I have read it as T. The mark after "Büchlein:" is an ornament, not a letter. "Keyf.May." is an abbreviation of Keyserl. Majestät; the f is read as printed. The handwritten name "Abraham Örber" with a flourish is an owner's signature and is not transcribed. The library stamp at the top right is not transcribed.
